subject: sty
title: STY.------WO.EXT.PRI.
description: Chart on book p. 390 (NYM-24). STY (style) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; WO-EXT-PRI is the partner. From the subject: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis). From SPT-DY: PART (participation). From MT-IF-DB: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: AFTD (affinity tendencies). From AFTD: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From PHY-U-P: SOC-RT (social reality). From SOC-RT: AF-NT (affinity nature).
